title: Explicit Bicanonical Models of Eight Fake Quadrics
summary: We compute explicit defining equations for eight fake quadrics arising as $\mathbb Z/2\times\mathbb Z/4$-covers of two singular $\mathbb Z/2$-Godeaux surfaces obtained in earlier work of the second author. Starting from explicit equations for the universal covers of the Godeaux surfaces, we reconstruct the relevant character eigenspaces and determine the homogeneous ideals of the bicanonical models of the eight fake quadrics in $\mathbb P^8$.
